title: cornus mas f. flava
intro: Cornus mas f. flava, commonly known as Golden Dogwood, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe and Western Asia, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and red berries. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cornus mas f. flava include stimulating digestion, lowering blood pressure, and acting as a diuretic, making it useful for treating conditions such as hypertension and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
